title: receiveTypingIndicators field def uses undefined term 'typing push event'
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md, the Chat object field definition for receiveTypingIndicators uses the phrase 'typing push event' before that term is introduced. The Push Notifications section is later in the document. A first-time reader working through the data type definitions will encounter this term without context. The field description should either use a term already defined at that point in the document, or add a forward reference to the push section.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
